errors.evidence: The y-axis range in the description states up to 28.5, but the figure shows the y-axis range up to 28.6.
The description correctly states the increments for α but does not clarify that the increments are fixed at 0.2 (minor omission of detail).
The description incorrectly states the x-axis increments for ρ as 0.15, but the figure shows increments of 0.1.
The description states the peak BLEU score as approximately 28.5, but the figure shows the peak at 28.55 for both α and ρ.
The description states the peak BLEU score as approximately 28.5, but the figure shows the peak at 28.55 for ρ = 0.15.
The description does not explicitly mention the y-axis uses a linear scale with 0.1 intervals.
The description omits the exact BLEU scores for α = 0.1 (28.00), α = 0.3 (28.32), α = 0.7 (28.40), and α = 0.9 (28.12).
The description omits the exact BLEU scores for p = 0.05 (28.30), p = 0.25 (28.38), p = 0.35 (28.44), and p = 0.45 (28.40).
The description does not mention that the impact of p on BLEU scores is slightly smaller than that of α.
The description omits the overall finding that optimal hyperparameter settings yield the best BLEU scores.
